jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. jobs.title: Growth & Paid Media Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.desc: Your tasks We are looking for a senior, hands-on growth marketer to own our paid channel strategy and make our media investment work harder. You will connect audience insight, creative campaigns, data and technology into a repeatable brand-to-demand engine. You can set direction, get into the platforms, challenge weak signals and show what is working in terms the business understands. Channel and investment strategy: You build a full-funnel media plan tied to FTAPI's target accounts, buying groups, priority campaigns and pipeline goals. You balance demand creation with demand capture and make budget trade-offs clear Campaign execution: You plan, launch and optimise paid search, paid social, programmatic display, sponsored content and retargeting. You test digital out-of-home and emerging channels where there is a sound audience and measurement case. You own budgets, pacing and agency or vendor performance, and execute directly when needed Audience and creative effectiveness: You use account, persona, intent and first-party insight to shape targeting and journeys. You work with Product Marketing, Campaigns, Brand and Sales to test messages, offers, creative and landing pages for CIOs, CISOs and other decision-makers Measurement and commercial impact: You partner with Marketing Operations and RevOps to connect media activity to CRM opportunities and revenue. You establish conversion, naming, UTM, tracking QA and reporting standards. You use attribution as one input to investment decisions and explain its limits clearly A scalable operating model: You build briefs, targeting rules, creative requirements, launch checklists and campaign blueprints that improve the speed and consistency of activation Experimentation and AI: You run a disciplined test roadmap across audiences, creative, landing pages and channel mix. You use AI to accelerate research, analysis, creative iteration, reporting and workflow automation, with human review and clear measures of impact Your profile Substantial hands-on B2B paid media and growth experience, ideally with complex technology and mid-market or enterprise buying groups Evidence that your work improved qualified pipeline, opportunity progression or revenue, not just clicks and lead volume Strong command of search and paid social, plus judgment about when other channels merit investment. You can challenge platform defaults and agency recommendations Fluency in CRM-linked measurement, conversion tracking, experimentation, funnel analysis and budget allocation A practical AI-enabled approach: you can describe workflows you've built, what they improved and how you checked their outputs Commercial judgment and ownership: you diagnose problems, recommend action and follow through without waiting for a perfect brief The ability to turn complex performance data into clear recommendations for Marketing, Sales, RevOps and senior leadership You work confidently in German and English (C1) What we offer Collegial environment: A team of around 140 people who will welcome you with open arms, support you, and with whom you'll have a lot of fun Comprehensive onboarding modern equipment: On your first day, you'll receive an onboarding package of modern hardware (headset, monitor, etc.). If you're a developer, you decide for yourself which hardware you'd like to work with. In your first few weeks, you'll get a buddy by your side and go through a structured onboarding process Sports or shopping: With EGYM Wellpass, you can use a wide range of sports and wellness offerings across Germany. Prefer home workouts or shopping? No problem! Choose a voucher of your choice worth €50 per month Job bike or Deutschland Ticket: Choose whether you'd rather have your Job Rad (company bike) or your Deutschland Ticket subsidized. If you go for the Deutschland Ticket, you only pay €23 yourself. And the best part: you can still sign a Job Rad contract, it just won't be subsidized Boost your (mental) well-being with Nilo Health: Book 1:1 coaching sessions with leading psychologists or access countless workshops and round tables on a variety of topics, whether private or work-related Take a break from everyday work with 30 days of vacation: Rest and recharge so you can come back and get going together with us Mobile working: We'd love to see you in the office! We have all kinds of treats and other perks there to make working together not only fun, but also well catered. Mobile working is completely flexible in most teams and possible by arrangement in some teams Relocating? We've got your back! Moving for your new job with us? We'll support you with up to €2,000 so that your start with us goes as smoothly as possible Professional development: FTAPI is growing, and so that you can grow with us, you have various options and a budget to drive your development forward Top-notch catering: Didn't have time for a leisurely breakfast after getting up? No problem, we've got you covered! At FTAPI, there's a huge selection of muesli and fruit. When the weather is nice, we love to grill on our roof terrace, and if you hit an afternoon slump, you'll find plenty of snacks in our kitchen Regular team and company events: Whether it's the summer party, Wiesn, Christmas party, or grilling on our roof terrace, there's always something going on Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Manager, Paid Media
jobs.desc: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the Role We’re seeking a data-driven and creative Paid Media Manager to plan, execute, and optimize digital campaigns across global paid channels. You’ll own the performance and day-to-day management of paid search, paid social, and display campaigns that drive acquisition, pipeline growth, and ROI. In this role, you’ll blend analytical rigor with hands-on execution — partnering closely with Growth Strategy, Product Marketing, Creative, and Analytics to translate business objectives into efficient, scalable campaigns. You’ll be instrumental in building the frameworks, insights, and best practices that power our global demand generation engine. Key Responsibilities Strategy Planning Develop and execute multi-channel paid media strategies (SEM, paid social, programmatic/display, YouTube, retargeting) aligned with funnel goals and business priorities. Own budget planning, forecasting, and pacing to meet CAC, ROAS, and pipeline targets. Collaborate with regional and product marketing teams to localize campaigns and ensure relevance across markets. Recommend new growth opportunities, audiences, and channels based on data-driven insights. Execution Optimization Build and manage paid campaigns end-to-end: keyword/audience selection, ad copy, creative testing, and bid strategy. Continuously optimize for performance , leveraging testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate, holdout experiments) to improve CTR, CVR, and CPL. Monitor and report on campaign performance daily and weekly, identifying trends and actionable insights. Ensure proper tracking and attribution (UTMs, pixels, offline conversions, Salesforce/Marketo sync). Manage and QA all campaign builds following standardized naming conventions and governance frameworks . Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Creative and Content to develop ad variations tailored to audience segments and funnel stages. Collaborate with Analytics and RevOps to ensure visibility into lead quality, pipeline contribution, and ROI. Work with Product Marketing to align messaging, audience strategy, and campaign sequencing. Testing Insights Maintain a structured testing roadmap across channels for creative, audience, and bidding experiments. Surface insights on platform algorithm changes, auction dynamics, and audience performance trends. Share performance learnings across regions to scale best practices globally. Qualifications 5–8 years of experience managing paid media programs in B2B SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce environments. Deep hands-on expertise in the breadth of DemandGen and Acquisition and across ad unit types in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads (other platforms like YouTube, Reddit, Quora, and programmatic are a plus). Proven success optimizing campaigns for pipeline, ROI, and LTV:CAC efficiency. Strong analytical skills; comfortable using Excel/Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or GA4 to analyze campaign data. Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce). Exceptional project management and attention to detail — able to run multiple campaigns simultaneously. Excellent communicator who can translate performance data into actionable business insights. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: An extensible, integration-ready enterprise-grade IAM solution is integral to Camunda’s long-term strategy. As our next Engineering Manager for Identity, you’ll lead the team that builds and delivers the Identity and Access Management (IAM) foundation that powers the entire Camunda 8 platform, both on-premise and as part of our SaaS offering. This is a key role which can have a deep impact on Camunda’s success, offering you the chance to have a direct impact on the company’s growth. As engineering manager, you will be tasked with end-to-end delivery of said solutions, and work closely with other engineering teams to ensure they are well integrated across the entire stack, making it secure, enterprise-ready, and easy to integrate at scale. You will coach and grow your team in order to deliver a high quality product within a predictable timeframe. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs. What You Will Do: Own end-to-end delivery of reusable IAM components across the Camunda 8 stack—shaping authentication (multi‑protocol), authorization (RBAC), and federated organization management that work seamlessly for large, integration‑heavy enterprises. Partner closely with multiple engineering teams, SREs, QA, and the Product Leadership Team to develop and drive a clear technical and product vision; transparently steward the roadmap and track commitments from support, incidents, and the product backlog. Raise the bar on reliability and efficiency: keep build/release pipelines low‑effort and stable, ship security fixes within SLOs, and drive down support load, bug count, and incident rate. Grow and coach a team of senior and developing engineers—setting clear expectations, giving actionable feedback, and creating a culture of autonomy, accountability, and continuous improvement, especially in an asynchronous, remote environment aligned to the DRI model. Help mature our SaaS offering for large scale enterprise customers, ensuring it can easily integrate with our customer’s own IAM solutions in a safe, reliable way. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: Senior‑level technical depth in IAM and enterprise software: you can review designs, ask the right questions, and represent your team to technical and non‑technical stakeholders with clarity. Proven track record leading medium‑to‑large delivery: you have owned 6‑month‑scale projects from inception to release, guiding 3–5+ engineers, writing solution designs and project plans, and delivering on time without micromanagement in a remote, asynchronous setting. Hands-on experience either implementing or integrating IAM solutions; you understand protocols like OIDC and SAML and how they work in complex enterprise environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management: you translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, can speak with customers when needed, and drive decisive, low‑churn outcomes. Background in product engineering for integration‑heavy B2B products (not primarily consulting), with a deep appreciation for enterprise needs around security, operability, and performance. Ability and/or willingness to use our product . Nice to Haves: Experience with workflow orchestration platforms or similar distributed systems. Familiarity with Spring Security and the broader Spring ecosystem. Experience implementing IAM federation. Experience with clustered/distributed, eventually consistent applications. Experience with L3 support/incident management. Experience working in a fully remote organization. jobs.desc: About Us ten23 health is a human-centric and sustainable strategic partner of choice for the pharmaceutical industry and biotech start-ups for the development, manufacture, and testing of tomorrow’s medicines. We support our clients in developing differentiated, stable, usable, and safe injectable treatments for patients. Your mission We are looking for a Senior Automation OT Engineer to develop our automation strategy while ensuring the day-to-day reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement of the operational technology running our production equipment. Sitting at the intersection of automation engineering and IT operations, you will lead complex projects and act as the primary technical expert for the shop floor. You will balance hands-on troubleshooting of PLCs and servers with structured, GMP-compliant change management to support safe, efficient manufacturing. Key Responsibilities Strategy Leadership: Co - develop and support the site's overall automation strategy. Manage project pipelines, budgets, CAPEX/OPEX engineering tasks, and end-to-end hardware/software lifecycle planning. Systems Operations IT: Execute daily maintenance and troubleshooting for automation hardware (HMIs, PLCs). Administer if applicable underlying IT infrastructure, including Windows Servers, OS patching, OT network segmentation, and cybersecurity hygiene. Process Equipment Expertise: Oversee automation systems for critical fill and finish operations, including filling lines, isolators, freeze dryers, autoclaves and building utilities. GMP CSV Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to cGMP, Data Integrity, and CSV regulations. Draft and update technical documentation, execute rigorous change control, and support validation activities. Disaster Recovery: Maintain and regularly test backup/restore and disaster recovery procedures to ensure the uptime and validated state of all production equipment. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with manufacturing, QA, and maintenance teams to optimize systems. Manage vendor SLAs, maintain spare parts inventory, and provide on-call support for critical system alarms. Your profile We are looking for a motivated and committed professional who is ready to actively grow with us, combining in-depth technical knowledge with a pronounced cooperative spirit. The ideal candidate possesses: Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years of hands-on industrial automation or IT experience within a GMP Pharma environment, ideally with direct exposure to fill and finish operations. Strong technical proficiency in automation hardware (PLC SCADA Systems), HMI/SCADA configuration, Windows Server administration, and OT cybersecurity fundamentals. Proven leadership experience with excellent communication skills, structured problem-solving under pressure, and a strong ownership mindset. Deep familiarity with GMP/CSV concepts (GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11) and modern data integration architecture. Fluent in English (working language); German is a strong advantage for on-site shop floor communication. Why us? We offer a dynamic environment where you can contribute meaningfully, collaborate with exceptional minds, and unlock your full potential. Here's what sets ten23 apart: A valuable and impactful career development opportunity in an inspiring environment Flexible working arrangements and environment with an open culture and diverse workforce The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees Our learning and self-developing culture offers a wide range of training options Competitive pension fund plan, annual bonus, and other financial and non-financial benefit At ten23 we believe in self-responsibility and mutual trust. Therefore, we will provide our employees as much flexibility as possible and limit any bureaucracy to a minimum, whilst ensuring compliance with all applicable laws.
